focus: City of Philadelphia (Center City, Rittenhouse, Logan Square, Midtown Village, Old City, Queen Village, Northern Liberties, Fairmount, University City, South Philadelphia, Wynnefield, Roxborough, Chestnut Hill, Kensington, and Northeast Philadelphia)
intro: This first Philadelphia page covers 16 UPS Store locations inside the city whose official location and mailbox-services pages list a street address, staffed hours, and package acceptance from all carriers — from Center City, Old City, and University City out to Chestnut Hill, Roxborough, and Northeast Philadelphia. 15 of them publish Sunday hours. It is not a complete inventory: independent pack-and-ship stores and suburbs such as Cherry Hill, Upper Darby, King of Prussia, and Bensalem are not covered yet. The UPS Store pages mention 24-hour access only at participating locations, so that flag is off for every store here. Box availability can change; treat it as something to confirm. If you cannot get to a storefront, compare virtual mailbox services.

listings.name: The UPS Store — 10871 Bustleton Ave

hours.notes: Staffed store hours from the official location page’s opening-hours data. Holiday hours can differ; the page lists Thanksgiving Day (November 26) as closed.

listings.carriersNotes: The official mailbox-services page for this store says mailbox customers get package acceptance from all carriers, plus mail holding and forwarding. It does not list carrier names. Confirm any size or signing limits with the store.
listings.visitNotes: The mailbox-services page lists “24-hour access (at participating locations),” which does not confirm after-hours lobby access at this store. Box availability is not published as live inventory. Confirm with the store that a box is actually open.
